state_note: This artifact records executable mechanism disposition only. Source claims, frozen hypotheses, reproduction observations, and strategy proposals remain separate.

changes.title: Transactional lease store with store-issued monotonic fences
behavior: Serializes claim, transfer, renewal, and commit with SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions.
Allocates fence 1 on first claim and increments exactly once on each expired-lease ownership transfer.
Requires exact current fence, owner, lease ID, and an unexpired lease before commit.
Checks authority before idempotency replay so historical callbacks cannot regain authority.
Binds duplicate callbacks to the same task, owner, lease, fence, idempotency key, payload digest, and byte count.
changes.disposition_basis: Twenty-three focused tests pass after repairing a post-test review finding: the commit clock must be sampled after acquiring the transaction lock. The new adversarial test holds that lock across expiry and proves the delayed commit is rejected. The two-thread stale-worker fixture committed only fence 2; 64 independent fixture iterations blocked all 64 stale attempts with zero false acceptance.
changes.applied_scope: This owned WA-014 unit only; no shared controller or protected state was modified.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Accept any caller token greater than or equal to the stored token
rejected_candidates.reason: It lets a worker guess future authority; exact equality is required and adversarially tested.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Check idempotency before checking current ownership
rejected_candidates.reason: It can return success to a stale callback after transfer; ownership validation deliberately precedes replay.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Use process-local locks without a durable row
rejected_candidates.reason: Separate workers would not share current ownership or a monotonic allocation point.
